title: 403 long option trades, 15% win rate. Posting because I only ever see the winning screenshots
author: QuanTradin
selftext:
Paper, real quotes, month of it. Long option side came out at 15% wins across 403 trades, −$300,517.

Same window, shares instead: 47% wins, −$56,578 across 2,095 trades. Nearly flat.

Same signals in a lot of cases. The wrapper was the entire difference and it cost about six times more than everything else combined.

Worst single trade was −$20,330. Average loser overall is −$384 against an average winner of +$189, so I'm losing two dollars for every one I make and winning less than half the time. Bad combination.

Genuinely asking, does anyone here run a long premium book that clears its costs over a few thousand trades? Every time I work through the maths you need direction and timing and size of move all right, and I keep missing at least one.
